annotations.title: Get a link to connect a social account

description: Creates a one-hour link the user opens in a browser to connect social accounts (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn, Bluesky…) to their PostWire account: the page shows each network as a button, signs in to it on the network's own page, and then offers the next one, so several networks can be connected from one link. Nothing is connected until the user completes it on the page. With platform the page offers only that network; with brand_id the accounts are connected to that brand. Instagram opens with Log in with Instagram (a Business or Creator account, no Facebook Page needed), and the page also offers connecting through a Facebook Page. Returns the url of that page and message_for_user: one plain sentence telling the person what to do.

brand_id.description: Brand to connect it to. Omit for the default brand.

platform.description: Platform to connect. Omit to let the user choose on the page.
